title: Binance Futures Will Update the Price Index Components of USDⓈ-Margined XAUUSDT Perpetual Contract (2026-01-29)
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance constantly reviews its product and service offerings to ensure the best user experience for all users. Effective from  2026-01-29 08:00 (UTC) , Binance Futures will update the price index components of USDⓈ-Margined XAUUSDT Perpetual Contract as below: Components Symbol Weightage Before Adjustment Weightage After Adjustment Binance PAXGUSDT 1% 1% Dxfeed XAU/USD:AFX 9% 33% Massive C.XAU/USD 45% 33% Pyth XAU 45% 33% Notes: This information is released as a Notice under Binance  Exchange Rule  17. Users may visit the  Price Index  page to view the latest price index components. API users may query via this endpoint:  /fapi/v1/constituents .  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions.
